notes: ACCESS: allmodern.com answered plain curl_cffi impersonation (HTTP 200) on most requests this session; rotating profiles (safari17_2_ios, safari15_5, chrome131, firefox133, edge101, safari184) cleared intermittent 429s from a subset of hosts/pages, no CAPTCHA/WAF interstitial was ever served, only a plain rate-limit 429 that a profile swap or short retry resolved -- consistent with the project's 'first block stops that request, not the target' pacing. robots.txt was fetched FIRST: single 'User-agent: *' group, no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot group anywhere, so no Claude-specific block exists. It explicitly Allows '/*/sb0/' '/*/sb1/' '/*/sb2/' (every leaf URL below is an /sb0/ listing) while otherwise disallowing generic '/*/sb*/'; '/cat/' hub pages are not mentioned at all (default allow). Sitemaps listed (seo-category-index.xml, seo-sb0-index.xml etc.) confirm AllModern runs the same Wayfair-family platform/URL shape (/cat/ hubs, /sb0/ leaf listings) referenced in the Wayfair (SR1) notes, verified independently here rather than assumed. TREE: built top-down from AllModern's own category navigation JSON (BlockBuilderCategoryStandardCategoryNavigation / categoryGroups) embedded in each page's React Server Component payload, starting at the site's own Bathroom department hub https://www.allmodern.com/bathroom/cat/bathroom-c1875705.html, which lists exactly 3 children: Bathroom Fixtures + Hardware (c1864585), Bathroom Vanities + Mirrors (c1875706), Bath Linens + Accessories (c366847). All 3 were walked; the first two of those in turn had 2 more /cat/ sub-hubs (Bathroom Sinks + Faucets c1875394, Tubs + Tub Faucets c1875395), also walked to their leaf children. No node was found sitemap-only beyond what the nav already covered. QTY: every leaf number is the page's own rendered result-count header captured from the BlockBuilderBrowseResultCount component's literal text, e.g. '43 Items', '290 Items' -- the same rendering pattern documented for Wayfair. Every leaf's canonical URL was checked against the requested URL and matches exactly (no bad-slug wrong-number cases found). DEDUP (cross-category, mandatory): every candidate leaf URL was checked against pipeline/bathroom_json_archive/cross_category_url_index.json programmatically before recording. Hits: Vanity Mirrors (bathroom/sb0/vanity-mirrors-c409317.html, 60 Items) already in Wall_Decor.xlsx -> moved to review despite bathroom.md rules 10/11 wanting it as Bathroom, per the mandatory cross-category-dedup addendum (Option-1 rule: a prior category's recorded leaf always wins over what Bathroom's own rules would separately want); Bath Towels, Hand Towels, Bath Mats, Shower Curtains already in Textile.xlsx -> review; Vanity Lighting already in Lighting.xlsx -> review; Hampers + Baskets already in Storage.xlsx -> review. ROUTED OUT (would have been review anyway on Bathroom's own rules, and dedup confirms none were missed): Vanity Lighting -> Lighting (rules 11/19, primary type is lighting); Bath Towels/Hand Towels/Shower Curtains/Bath Mats -> Textile (rules 15/16/20, textile bath linens; AllModern's own Bath Mats node title 'Modern Bath Rugs + Mats' confirms it is the textile rug/mat node, not a rubber anti-slip mat, so Textile is correct per rule 16); Hampers + Baskets -> Storage (rule 12/31, generic storage baskets, URL lives under /storage/ not /bathroom/). Two additional out-of-scope nodes surfaced in the Bathroom Fixtures + Hardware nav block but are NOT genuinely Bathroom-owned: Floor + Wall Tile (wall-decor-mirrors/sb0/floor-wall-tile-c1864536.html, 147 Items) is a building-material tile listing, not a Bathroom fixture/furniture/storage/accessory type under rules 3-18, so it is routed to review as out-of-scope/Tiles; Cabinet Knobs + Pulls (kitchen-tabletop/cat/cabinet-knobs-pulls-c1875324.html, 32 Items) has its own breadcrumb parent as Kitchen Fixtures + Hardware (categoryId 1864586), i.e. it is a Kitchen-owned generic cabinet-hardware node merely cross-listed in the Bathroom nav block, not a bathroom-specific hardware product per rule 29's disambiguation test, so it is routed to review as out-of-scope rather than recorded as Bathroom. KEPT AS BATHROOM: Bathroom Sinks (43), Bathroom Faucets (75), Tubs + Whirlpools (36), Tub Faucets (50), Shower + Tub Doors (29), Shower Heads (47), Toilets (20), Toilet Paper Holders (16), Bathroom Vanities (290, rule 9 -- AllModern's own hierarchy files this under Bathroom, not Furniture, and it is not present in Furniture.xlsx per the dedup check), Medicine Cabinets (34, rule 9/12, same reasoning, no dedup hit), Countertop Bathroom Accessories (110), Trash Cans (65). PARENT URLS: never recorded for the 5 grouping nodes (Bathroom, Bathroom Fixtures + Hardware, Bathroom Sinks + Faucets, Tubs + Tub Faucets, Bathroom Vanities + Mirrors, Bath Linens + Accessories) since each has extractable leaf children (rule 24) -- emitted as is_group rows with qty/link null, each immediately followed by its children in reading order. No View-All/Shop-All/collection/search/promotional URLs were recorded anywhere in this tree.
